title: [2.8.2] Insulinampullenwechsel - Accu-Check Insight Pumpe / Insulin reservior changes - Accu-Check Insight Pump
symptom: When changing the insulin cartridge on the Accu-Check Insight pump, the age of the catheter is also reset. The change is logged in AAPS as 'Pumpenkatheter-Wechsel' (pump catheter change) which is incorrect. The issue occurs with Insight v3 pump and AAPS 2.8.2.
cause: The issue is specific to Insight pump firmware v3; it does not occur with firmware v2.
fix: The issue will be fixed in the next version of AAPS. A workaround is to turn off logging of reservoir changes in AAPS Insight settings and manually give a command 'Actions/Insulin Cartridge Change' in AAPS.
evidence_quote: This issue will be fixed in next version (note only firmware v3 has this issue, it works with firmware v2)
